metadata.name: Autonomous Agent with Tool Calling
metadata.description: ReAct agent that autonomously evaluates user goals, dynamically calls built-in calculation and lookup tools, and synthesizes answers.
metadata.author: PatchCat Team

inputs.user_query: I have 450 USD. Convert it to CNY using the current exchange rate, then apply a 3% transaction fee to tell me the net amount in CNY.

data.label: Financial Assistant Agent
data.description: ReAct agent with tools for exchange rate and math calculations

config.systemPrompt: You are a professional financial assistant agent. Use the available tools to find exchange rates and perform accurate arithmetic before providing the final answer.

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Get current currency exchange rate between two currencies
tools.implementation: const rates = { 'USD_CNY': 7.25, 'EUR_CNY': 7.85, 'JPY_CNY': 0.048 }; const key = inputs.from + '_' + inputs.to; return { rate: rates[key] || 7.25, from: inputs.from, to: inputs.to };

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Accurately compute mathematical operations like multiplication or percentage fees

data.label: Agent Response
data.description: Synthesized final answer from the agent
